title: High-frequency analytics and residential water consumption: Estimating heterogeneous effects
abstract: This paper estimates how high-frequency online Home Water Use Reports (HWURs) affect household-level water consumption. The HWURs under the study share social comparisons, consumption analytics, leak alerts, and conservation information to residential accounts, primarily through digital communications. The data utilized in this paper is a daily panel dataset that tracks single-family residential households from January 2013 to September 2019. We found a 6.2 % reduction in average daily household water consumption for a typical household enrolled in the program. We estimate heterogeneous treatment effects by the day of the week, the content of push notifications, and baseline consumption quintile. For the latter, we provide an illustrative test to emphasize how mean reversion can severely bias a naïve panel data estimator for heterogeneous treatment effects when the source of heterogeneity is the outcome variable. We also find evidence that leak alerts effectively reduce water consumption immediately following the alert. • High-frequency online Home Water Use Reports (HWURs) lead to a 6.2 % reduction in water consumption for a typical household enrolled in the program. • We estimate significant heterogeneity in the treatment effects depending on the day of the week, the content of push notifications, and the baseline consumption levels. • Our analysis indicates that leak alerts are particularly effective at reducing water consumption immediately after they are issued • We illustrate how mean reversion can bias a naïve panel estimator for heterogeneous treatment effects when heterogeneity arises from the outcome variable.
abstract_zh: 本文估计高频在线家庭用水报告（HWURs）如何影响家庭用水量。本研究中的HWURs主要通过数字通信向住宅用户发送社会比较、用水分析、漏水警报和节水信息。本文所用数据是一个日度面板数据集，追踪了2013年1月至2019年9月的独户住宅家庭。我们发现，对于一个典型的参与该项目的家庭，其日均用水量下降了6.2%。我们按星期几、推送通知的内容以及基线用水量五分位数估计异质性处理效应。针对最后一项，我们提供了一个示例性检验，以说明当异质性来源于结果变量本身时，均值回归如何会严重扭曲朴素的面板数据估计量对异质性处理效应的估计。我们还发现，漏水警报在发出后会立即有效减少用水量。• 高频在线家庭用水报告（HWURs）可使参与项目的典型家庭用水量减少6.2%。• 处理效应在星期几、推送通知内容以及基线用水水平方面存在显著异质性。• 我们的分析表明，漏水警报在发出后立即减少用水量的效果尤为显著。• 我们说明，当异质性源于结果变量时，均值回归可能使朴素面板估计量对异质性处理效应的估计产生偏误。

title: Consumer welfare consequences of the California drought conservation mandate
abstract: We measure consumer welfare losses from reductions in water use following California's conservation mandate in 2015, which imposed utility service area‐specific conservation targets of 4% up to 36%. We document imperfect compliance with the mandate and discuss factors that may explain the pattern of reductions ultimately observed. The basis for calculating welfare losses is an econometric model of residential water demand that yields local demands with elasticities ranging from −0.56 to −0.10. In terms of economic efficiency, we estimate a 20% gain in consumer welfare under the efficient allocation of conservation reductions relative to the observed pattern of reductions.
abstract_zh: 我们衡量了加州2015年节水强制令实施后，用水减少所带来的消费者福利损失。该强制令为各供水服务区设定了4%至36%不等的节水目标。我们记录了对该强制令的不完全遵守情况，并讨论了可能解释最终观察到的减水模式的因素。福利损失的计算基于一个住宅用水需求的计量经济模型，该模型得出的本地需求弹性范围为−0.56至−0.10。在经济效率方面，我们估计，相对于观察到的减水模式，若将节水减量按有效配置分配，消费者福利可提高20%。

Comparing water use forecasting model selection criteria: The case of commercial, institutional, and industrial sector in southern California
abstract: The United States is one of the largest per capita water withdrawers in the world, and certain parts of it, especially the western region, have long experienced water scarcity. Historically, the U.S. relied on large water infrastructure investments and planning to solve its water scarcity problems. These large-scale investments as well as water planning activities rely on water forecast studies conducted by water managing agencies. These forecasts, while key to the sustainable management of water, are usually done using historical growth extrapolation, conventional econometric approaches, or legacy software packages and often do not utilize methods common in the field of statistical learning. The objective of this study is to illustrate the extent to which forecast outcomes for commercial, institutional and industrial water use may be improved with a relatively simple adjustment to forecast model selection. To do so, we estimate over 352 thousand regression models with retailer level panel data from the largest utility in the U.S., featuring a rich set of variables to model commercial, institutional, and industrial water use in Southern California. Out-of-sample forecasting performances of those models that rank within the top 5% based on various in- and out-of-sample goodness-of-fit criteria were compared. We demonstrate that models with the best in-sample fit yeild, on average, larger forecast errors for out-of-sample forecast exercises and are subject to a significant degree of variation in forecasts. We find that out-of-sample forecast error and the variability in the forecast values can be reduced by an order of magnitude with a relatively straightforward change in the model selection criteria even when the forecast modelers do not have access to “big data” or utilize state-of-the-art machine learning techniques.
abstract_zh: 美国是世界上人均取水量最大的国家之一，其部分地区，特别是西部地区，长期面临水资源短缺问题。历史上，美国依靠大规模的水利基础设施投资和规划来解决水资源短缺问题。这些大规模投资以及水资源规划活动，依赖于水资源管理机构开展的水资源预测研究。这些预测对于水资源的可持续管理至关重要，但通常是采用历史增长外推法、传统计量经济学方法或传统软件包完成的，往往未能采用统计学习领域的常用方法。本研究旨在说明，通过对预测模型选择进行相对简单的调整，商业、机构和工业用水的预测结果可以在多大程度上得到改善。为此，我们利用美国最大供水公司的零售商层面面板数据，估计了超过35.2万个回归模型，该数据包含对南加利福尼亚商业、机构和工业用水建模的丰富变量。我们比较了在多种样本内和样本外拟合优度标准下排名前5%的模型的样本外预测表现。我们证明，样本内拟合最好的模型，在样本外预测中平均产生更大的预测误差，并且其预测值存在显著的变异。我们发现，即使预测建模者无法获取“大数据”或未采用最先进的机器学习技术，仅通过相对直接地改变模型选择标准，也可以将样本外预测误差和预测值的变异性降低一个数量级。

title: Forecasting Residential Water Consumption in California: Rethinking Model Selection
abstract: Urban water managers use forecasts of water consumption to determine management decisions and investment choices. Public reports show that water utilities rely on forecast models that are not selected based on their out‐of‐sample prediction performance; further, these reports frequently only present a single forecast instead of a range of forecasts. In our review of the academic literature on forecasting long‐term water consumption, only a few analyses consider out‐of‐sample prediction performance measures to assess prediction ability. In none of these analyses did out‐of‐sample prediction performance drive model selection. Ensemble‐type long‐term forecasts based on multiple models were also lacking. Using annual data on single‐family residential water consumption in Southern California, we show that predictive ability varies drastically depending on how the forecast model is selected. As an illustration of how forecast performance is affected when the criteria for model selection does support forecasting objectives, we compare statistical models with the best in‐sample and out‐of‐sample prediction performance. We find that the models with the best in‐sample performance over‐estimate consumption five years out by 10%‐25% compared to actual consumption. In contrast, the top 1% of models selected based on out‐of‐sample prediction performance came within 1% of actual consumption. Finally, we compare the performance of our ensemble‐type forecasts to those reported in public documents derived from models selected based on non‐out‐of‐sample prediction performance criteria. Our results highlight the benefits of (i) using an out‐of‐sample evaluation criterion to guide model selection and (ii) reporting ensemble forecasts in lieu of a single forecast.
abstract_zh: 城市水务管理者利用用水量预测来确定管理决策和投资选择。公开报告显示，供水公司所依赖的预测模型，并非基于其样本外预测表现而选定；此外，这些报告通常只提供单一预测值，而非预测区间。在我们对长期用水量预测学术文献的回顾中，只有少数分析考虑了以样本外预测表现来评估预测能力。在这些分析中，没有一项是由样本外预测表现来驱动模型选择的。基于多个模型的集合型长期预测也较为缺乏。利用南加利福尼亚单户住宅年度用水数据，我们表明，预测能力会因预测模型的选择方式而大相径庭。作为一个说明，当模型选择标准符合预测目标时，预测表现会受到何种影响，我们比较了样本内与样本外预测表现最佳的统计模型。我们发现，样本内表现最佳的模型，在五年后高估了10%至25%的用水量，相比之下，依据样本外预测表现选出的前1%模型，与实际用水量的偏差在1%以内。最后，我们将集合型预测的表现，与公开文件中基于非样本外预测标准选出的模型所得结果进行了比较。我们的结果凸显了以下两方面的益处：（i）采用样本外评估标准指导模型选择；（ii）报告集合预测而非单一预测值。

title: Recovering forecast distributions of crop composition: Method and application to Kentucky agriculture
abstract: This paper proposes a novel application of the multinomial logit (MNL) model using Cropland Data Layer and field-level boundaries to estimate crop transition probabilities, which are used to generate forecast distributions of total acreage for five major crops produced in the state of Kentucky. These forecasts distributions have a wide range of applications that, besides providing interim acreage estimates ahead of the June Acreage Survey, can inform the ability of producers to incorporate new crops in the land-use rotation, investments in location-specific capital and input distribution as well informing the likelihood of adverse water quality events from nutrient run-off.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种多项Logit（MNL）模型的新应用，利用耕地数据层（Cropland Data Layer）和田块级边界数据来估计作物转换概率，并以此生成肯塔基州五种主要作物总播种面积的预测分布。这些预测分布具有广泛的应用价值：除了能在六月播种面积调查（June Acreage Survey）之前提供阶段性面积估计外，还可帮助生产者判断是否将新作物纳入轮作体系，为基于地点的资本和投入品配置投资提供参考，并有助于判断养分径流导致不良水质事件的可能性。

title: The effect of the oil and gas boom on schooling decisions in the U.S.
Measuring welfare losses from urban water supply disruptions
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The paper evaluates welfare losses from urban water supply disruptions for a sample of 53 urban water utilities in California collectively providing service to over 20 million customers. The analysis accounts for the fact that most water utilities engage in a form of average cost pricing where volumetric rates are used to finance fixed expenses. We estimate utility-specific price elasticities for use in the welfare analysis, which are derived from a demand estimation based on a panel data set of 37 California water utilities. Welfare losses for an annual disruption range from an average of $1,458 per acre-foot of shortage for a 10% supply disruption to an average of $3,426 per acre-foot of shortage for a 30% supply disruption. The results indicate a household-level willingness to pay to avoid an annual disruption of approximately $60–$600 depending on the shortage size and location.
abstract_zh: 本文以加利福尼亚州53家城市供水公司的样本评估城市供水中断造成的福利损失，这些公司共同为超过2,000万用户提供服务。分析考虑了大多数供水公司采用平均成本定价的做法，即通过按用水量计费的方式来弥补固定费用。我们估算了各供水公司的价格弹性，用于福利分析，这些弹性来自基于37家加利福尼亚供水公司面板数据的需求估计。在年度中断情形下，福利损失为：供水短缺10%时，平均每英亩-英尺短缺损失1,458美元；供水短缺30%时，平均每英亩-英尺短缺损失3,426美元。结果表明，家庭层面为避免年度中断而愿意支付的金额约为60至600美元，具体取决于短缺规模和地点。

title: Land markets and the value of water: Hedonic analysis using repeat sales of farmland
abstract: The lack of robust water markets makes it difficult to value irrigation water. Because water rights are appurtenant to land, it is possible to infer the value of water from observed differences in the market price of land. We use panel data on repeat farmland sales in California's San Joaquin Valley to estimate a hedonic regression equation with parcel fixed effects. This controls for sources of omitted variables bias and allows us to recover the value of irrigation water to landowners in our sample. We show that a more traditional cross‐sectional regression results in an artificially low value of irrigation water.
abstract_zh: 缺乏稳健的水市场，使得灌溉用水的价值难以估量。由于水权附属于土地，我们可以从观察到的土地市场价格差异中推断水的价值。我们利用加利福尼亚州圣华金谷（San Joaquin Valley）农田重复销售的面板数据，估计了包含地块固定效应的享乐回归方程。这控制了遗漏变量偏误的来源，并使我们能够还原样本中土地所有者对灌溉用水的价值。我们表明，更为传统的截面回归会得出人为偏低的灌溉用水价值。

title: Agricultural extension, trust, and learning: Results from economic experiments in Ecuador
abstract: Using an artefactual economic experiment and a randomized training intervention in Ecuador we test if trust conditions a farmer’s decision to learn during an agricultural training. We present a simple model of farmer behavior during the agricultural training in order to link play in the laboratory to behavior in the field. We find evidence that farmers who trust agricultural technicians relatively more than community farmers in the trust game learn more during training. The results provide insight into the design of agricultural extension services in Ecuador.
abstract_zh: 本文利用人为设计的经济学实验以及厄瓜多尔的随机培训干预，检验了信任是否会影响农民在农业培训期间的学习决策。我们构建了一个简单的农民培训期间行为模型，将实验室中的博弈行为与田间行为联系起来。我们发现，在信任博弈中，相对于社区农民而言，更信任农业技术人员的农民，在培训中学到的东西更多。研究结果为厄瓜多尔农业推广服务的设计提供了启示。
